POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

2. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

5. When learning General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

6. When learning General workshop rules and regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

8. When learning Vehicle body joining processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body joining processes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body joining processes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body joining processes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body joining processes.

9. When learning Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.

10. When learning Vehicle body, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body.

11. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

12. When learning Blending of lines and curves, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending of lines and curves.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Blending of lines and curves.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending of lines and curves.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Blending of lines and curves and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Road wheels and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Vehicle body and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

2. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

3. C — CPU

4. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.

7. D — Information and Communication Technology

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body joining processes.

9. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.

11. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Blending of lines and curves; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Road wheels; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Vehicle body; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
